description: examples/c++/contact_mechanics_model/hertz/cohesive-contact mesh through CouplerSolidCohesiveContact _static (intrinsic cohesive_linear of material-cohesive.dat, epsilon_n = 1e3), compression of 1e-3/50 per step (loading -inc, fixed +inc, sides x fixed), Newton at 100 iterations, until the first Newton failure (at most 10 steps); callback trace of steps 0 and 1; composition of K (UD-772)
